Nour El Idrissi
Junior Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript, Python, LLMs)
Fes, Morocco · nour.elidrissi@example.com · https://github.com/example-nour

PROFILE
Recent Computer Science graduate with a 6-month full-stack internship and several shipped side projects that use LLM APIs.

EXPERIENCE
Full-Stack Developer Intern, Medina Pay (fintech startup), Fes · Feb 2025 – Jul 2025

- Wrote Jest unit tests for the payment-reconciliation module and fixed 30+ bugs from the backlog.

StudyBuddy, AI flashcard generator (Next.js, Cloudflare Workers, Gemini API) · 2025

JobFeed API (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL) · 2024

Portfolio site (Next.js, Tailwind CSS) · 2024

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Fes Institute of Computing · 2021 – 2025

SKILLS
Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, SQL
Frameworks: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Tailwind CSS
Data: PostgreSQL, Cloudflare D1
Tools: Git, GitHub, Jest, Linux, Cloudflare Workers
AI: Gemini API, OpenAI API, prompt engineering
Spoken languages: Arabic (native), French (fluent), English (fluent)
jobText:
Junior Full-Stack Developer
Tidewell · Remote (worldwide) · Full-time

Tidewell builds booking software for small surf and dive schools. We are a fully remote team of 9 spread over 7 countries, and we hire from anywhere in the world.

What you'll do
- Build features in our Next.js front end and Node.js API.
- Write SQL and keep our PostgreSQL database healthy.
- Ship small improvements every week and talk to customers about them.

Requirements
- Good knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript.
- Experience building interfaces with React.
- Experience with Node.js on the back end.
- Comfortable writing SQL queries (we use PostgreSQL).
- Comfortable with Git and code reviews.
- Good written English.

Nice to have
- Next.js.
- Cloudflare Workers or other edge platforms.
- You have used an LLM API (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) in a project.
- Some Python.

Location
Work from anywhere in the world. We pay contractors through Deel in USD.

Salary: 28,000–36,000 USD per year.
